body.x: With the support from Daegu Technopark Mobile Convergence Center, RNS (CEO Kim Jun-seong) will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its plastic compression sheets for future use.
This product is used as a new material for construction in various fields, and it can maintain a clean surface by using co-extrusion method to prevent yellowing.
Also, it is used in various places such as construction companies, TV monitor companies, industrial machinery companies, and advertisement signs.
The company is expanding the market in the TV and LED lighting fields, and recently, it has been developing new markets in various areas by developing security sheets and insect prevention sheets.

By developing and producing various types of engineer plastics, the company is developing materials that are beneficial to the world, contributing to the future for people, technology for people and a more innovative tomorrow.

Gyeongbuk Province has formed Daegu Joint Pavilion where 44 ICT convergence ventures and SMEs and three startups will be participating. Major programs include exhibitions, investor pitching, public relations with foreign media, and post-CES review conferences. In CES 2019, Daegu and Gyeongbuk Province exchanged MOU to run joint pavilion in CES for the benefits of both parties, and the joint pavilion has been set up in CES 2020. The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global technology issues and trends at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
